part.text:
Now I can see the issue clearly. Let me look at the `search_imp` function more carefully, specifically the slot clearing and the `find_match` function.

The problem is in `search_imp` at line 2096-2106 and in `find_match` at line 2217-2223. When `slots.len()` is larger than the number of slots the regex actually uses, the code at line 2096-2098 computes `explicit_slots_len` using `slots.len().saturating_sub(self.explicit_slot_start)`, which could exceed `Slots::LIMIT`. Then `cache.setup_search(explicit_slots_len)` could panic or behave incorrectly.

But more importantly, in `find_match` at line 2217-2223, when `self.explicit_slot_start < slots.len()`, it does `slots[self.explicit_slot_start..].copy_from_slice(cache.explicit_slots())`. The `cache.explicit_slots()` slice length is set up in `setup_search` based on `explicit_slots_len`. If `explicit_slots_len` was clamped to `Slots::LIMIT` but `slots[self.explicit_slot_start..]` is longer, this `copy_from_slice` will panic.
